body: Library Board of Trustees Special Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MARCH 11, 2020 – 5:00 P.M.
  THORNTON CONFERENCE ROOM – CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
CALL TO ORDER Chairperson Mollno called the meeting to order at 5:00 P.M. in the
Thornton Conference Room at the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino,
California 91108.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE Chairperson Mollno led the Pledge of Allegiance
ROLL CALL  PRESENT: Chairperson Linda Mollno, Vice Chairperson Liz
  Hollingsworth, Trustee Lois Derry, Trustee Eldon Swanson, and Alternate
  Steve Domier
  ABSENT: Trustee Mary Hsu and Alternate Genevieve Chien
  CITY STAFF PRESENT: Community Services Director Josette
  Espinosa, Parks and Public Works Director Michael Throne, Community
  Engagement Manager Amanda Fowler, City Librarian Irene McDermott,
  and Management Analyst Robert Zubiate
PUBLIC COMMENTS
The following person(s) spoke:
NONE
NEW BUSINESS
  1. DISCUSSION OF PROPOSED CIP ITEMS FOR FY 20-21

  The Board discussed the list of projects proposed to be included in the City’s Capital
  Improvement Plan and gained input from Director Throne for the purposes of the
  discussion.

  Vice Chairperson Hollingsworth moved to request that the City Manager increase the
  Sidewalk Replacement Project funding in the Parks and Public Works FY 20-21 Operating
  budget to replace the sidewalk pathways at the Crowell Public Library; seconded by
  Alternate Domier. The motion carried unanimously by the following votes: AYES:
  Chairperson Mollno, Vice Chairperson Hollingsworth, Trustee Derry, Trustee Swanson,
  and Alternate Domier. NOES: None.

  Vice Chairperson Hollingsworth moved to direct staff to convey within the City Council
  CIP staff report the Board’s support for the Library’s FY 20-21 proposed CIP projects to
  include the window tinting, computer room renovation, and bottle-watering station;
  seconded by Alternate Domier. The motion carried unanimously by the following votes:

  1
   AYES: Chairperson Mollno, Vice Chairperson Hollingsworth, Trustee Derry, Trustee
  Swanson, and Alternate Domier. NOES: None.

  Vice Chairperson Hollingsworth moved to direct staff to convey within the City Council
  CIP staff report the Board's support for the Library's FY 2l-22 proposed CIP projects to
  include the Barth Room lighting upgrades and security cameras upgrades; seconded by
  Trustee Swanson. The motion carried unanimously by the following votes: AYES:
  Chairperson Mollno, Vice Chairperson Hollingsworth, Trustee Derry, Trustee Swanson,
  and Alternate Domier. NOES: None.

  Vice Chairperson Hollingsworth moved to direct staff to convey within the City Council
  CIP staff report the Board's support for the Community Services CIP procurement of
  ActiveNet; seconded by Alternate Domier. The motion carried unanimously by the
  following votes: AYES: Chairperson Mollno, Vice Chairperson Hollingsworth, Trustee
  Derry, Trustee Swanson, and Alternate Domier. NOES: None.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED
There were no public writings distributed.

PUBLIC COMMENTS
There were no public comments at this time.

ADJOURNMENT
Chairperson Mollno adjourned the meeting at 6: l2 P.M. to a Regular Meeting on MONDAY,
MARCH 23,2020 AT 7:30 A.M. in the Thornton Conference Room at the Crowell Public Library,
1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 9l 108.
